🎥🎬: Bad Teacher (2011)

Elizabeth Halsey is a foul-mouthed, lazy middle school teacher who only cares about getting enough money to leave her job and live a more comfortable life. When her plans for an easy escape fall apart, she begins chasing a new opportunity that could change everything.

While trying to win over a wealthy substitute teacher, Elizabeth gets caught up in a ridiculous competition with a dedicated colleague. Her selfish schemes create chaos at school, but unexpected moments force her to rethink what kind of person—and teacher—she wants to become.

source_details.title: Bad Teacher
source_details.synopsis: Bad Teacher is a 2011 American comedy film directed by Jake Kasdan and written by the writing team of Lee Eisenberg and Gene Stupnitsky. Starring Cameron Diaz, Justin Timberlake, Lucy Punch, John Michael Higgins, and Jason Segel, the film tells the story of a middle school teacher who hates her job, her students, and her co-workers, but returns to teaching after her wealthy fiancé breaks up with her. Bad Teacher was released in the United States on June 24, 2011, by Columbia Pictures. It received mixed reviews from critics and grossed $216 million.
